scope: Provisional digital architecture and budget inputs; no human stimulation prescription or efficacy result

selection.motor_task: Paced alternating foot-placement sequence with direction changes and measured contact/timing error
selection.physiology_endpoint: Externally measured systolic pressure after SCI; pressor-only authority
selection.access: S1-ARCH-02: intradural surface recording plus separate epidural stimulation
selection.application_concurrency: Mutually exclusive motor and pressure reference modes
selection.anatomical_configuration: Contact inventory is per configured target-specific variant. Coexisting motor/pressor lead sets require explicit repartition/recruitment validation or enlarged contact and package budgets
selection.evidence_status: Task and information availability are hypotheses; electrical allocations are design choices

recording.candidate: Intan RHD2216; official typical specifications are feasibility witnesses, not implant qualification

compute.candidate: nRF5340 application core; network/radio budget included in power allocation
compute.update_storage_policy: Single application image; no resident second image or network-update cache. Maintenance/recovery is a quiescent service mode. Atomic OTA updates are not included or qualified.
compute.provenance: Manufacturer capacity plus chosen allocations/analytical cycle estimates. Compact coefficients/state share feature RAM; immutable expert policy resides in application flash. Firmware WCET and final memory layout pending

telemetry.provenance: Application service targets; radio PHY capability does not prove these through-tissue payload capacities

stimulation.source_service_provenance: Chosen bound: two 500us phases +100us interphase +250us zero-current admission/reconfiguration. Must be qualified by actual circuit/firmware; not a 150Hz per-source ceiling.
stimulation.provenance: Chosen hardware envelope with primary-study/device witnesses; material-specific charge-injection validity unestablished

monitoring.adc_candidate: TI ADS7953; independent of the neural ADC
monitoring.provenance: ADC capacity is manufacturer evidence; analog gain/offset/edge and guard allocations require Stage 4 circuit/transient validation

output_configuration_bus.peripheral: SPIM1, separate from SPIM0 neural and SPIM4 delivery monitor
output_configuration_bus.instantaneous_edge_owner: Local timer/DPPI and independent output gate; SPI is for zero-current preload, not live phase-edge timing
output_configuration_bus.provenance: Chosen finite command-size/timing allocation; SPIM1 8Mbps capacity is a Nordic witness. Actual DAC, routing words and gate sequencing remain Stage4.

power.provenance: Cell dimensions/capacity/voltage are manufacturer data at stated conditions; efficiency, allocations, current cap, thermal model and 2 K target are chosen engineering assumptions, not clinical safety bounds

companion_power.pressure_instrument_power: Separately powered external instrument; no assertion that a continuous-pressure sensor fits or is powered by the small hub
companion_power.offline_studio_power: Externally powered host; not free computation inside implant
companion_power.provenance: Chosen finite companion source/base allocations; actual devices, charger-link losses, sensor power and portable consumer sensing remain unqualified

profiles.basis: Chosen digital practice profile; no biological effect is assumed
Study-inspired frame/offsets; amplitude and symmetric active recharge are our digital choices
Primary amplitude upper range combined with SCCI_RH symmetric waveform; sustained thermal and low-cell limits may reject it
Deliberate simultaneous-all-max failure; independent knob maxima are not permission for this combination

mechanical.battery_case: Case-negative: electrically isolate from package/body reference
mechanical.provenance: Battery box from manufacturer; can/board/header/hub are geometric allocations, not anatomical fit, hermetic or RF-qualified designs
